options.description: Options for the Cloudflare edge. The token and account id are read from the environment.

cache.description: Serve the project's container apps through its worker. A Next app ocel's adapter built is routed, cached and purged on revalidation as a serverless Next app is; any other app is kept by the cache headers it sends. On AWS and a VPS the worker fronts the load balancer or the box, and a box's files are kept in an R2 bucket per tier; on Google Cloud the worker already serves container apps and also keeps what they mark cacheable. Every request through the worker is billed, cache hits included.

tunnel.description: Reach the origin through a tunnel it opens to Cloudflare, instead of at its address. A VPS always does.
